newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT-Australian 10-yr bond eyeing the record.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Australian 10-yr bond eyeing the record.

text.p: *The Australian 10-year bond futures contract ended SYCOM trade little changed from Wednesday's pit close, keeping an attack on the all time record of 93.630 on the agenda.
*The contract hit a fresh 3-1/2 year high of 93.510 as it tracked an initial advance in U.S. Treasuries.
However, there are some doubts that if the record is breached that the market will rally on much further.

"If they take out the high, I don't think there are going to be a lot of stop losses up there. The stress buying should have already been done," said Peter Pontikis, technical strategist at Westpac. "If people are worried about that level, they would have done their buying in the last couple of days."

The market could see a mildly negative session on Friday given the strong rebound from Wednesday's 93.235 low and as the market is becoming overbought with its 14-day relative strength index nudging 75 percent again.
